info.title: Jadwigo API
info.description: The API behind app.jadwigo.pl: attempts at lessons, the parent screens and the question bank. Every request and reply body is JSON.

get.summary: Answers when the API is up.
Lists the featured lessons anyone may play.
get.description: The featured pod's open `anyone` assignments, oldest first.

get.summary: Lists the playground's authored examples in one language, with their keys.
get.description: The one response that carries a key: the playground reviews Jadwigo's own examples, and Try it looks a free answer up in the key.

post.summary: Starts an attempt at an assignment.

get.summary: Lists one assignment's attempts the caller's pod may read: the lesson overview.
get.description: 404 when the pod reads none of them.

get.summary: Reads an attempt: its plan and everything asked so far.
get.description: No sign-in: the attempt id is the access, and whoever holds it may use it.

patch.description: No sign-in: the attempt id is the access, and whoever holds it may use it. The server finishes an attempt itself.

post.summary: Sends one try at the current question, or a skip.
post.description: No sign-in: the attempt id is the access, and whoever holds it may use it. Strict: a field the server owns (`correct`, `mistake_class`, `help_used`) is refused. Idempotent by `event_id`.

post.summary: Releases the next rung of help for one question.
post.description: No sign-in: the attempt id is the access, and whoever holds it may use it. The page sends the `help_released` it has seen, so a retried request returns the same rung. Rung 4 ends the question skipped and asks its twin.

get.summary: Reads an attempt's results in question order, mid-lesson too.
get.description: No sign-in: the attempt id is the access, and whoever holds it may use it.

get.summary: Reads a finished attempt's questions again, for the child.
get.description: No sign-in: the attempt id is the access, and whoever holds it may use it. 409 `AttemptNotFinished` before the attempt ends.

get.summary: Reads the signed-in adult: account, pod and learners.
get.description: Before the first sign-in has made an account, `account`, `member` and `pod` are null and `learners` is empty.

post.summary: Makes the account and pod on the first sign-in.
post.description: Idempotent per signed-in user: a second call makes nothing and returns the same reply.

post.summary: Adds a child to the caller's pod.
post.description: The server makes the `handle`, unique in the pod, from the first name.

post.summary: Attaches an anonymous attempt to a learner in the caller's pod.
post.description: A replay by the same account for the same learner returns the stored claim; any other claim of a claimed attempt is 409 `AttemptClaimed`.

get.summary: Lists a learner's attempts, newest first.
Reads a finished attempt of the caller's learner, with every try.
Reads where a learner stands on each skill, each goal's lists and the brief.
get.description: Folded on read from the learner's evidence: code computes every level, status and list. No level name, score or percentage is ever shown to the parent.

get.summary: Lists the skill catalogue the caller's pod reads.
get.description: The pod's own skills and the shared catalogue's, a pod's own row winning for its code.

get.summary: Lists a learner's goals with their skills, oldest first.

post.summary: Adds a goal to a learner, in the parent's words, with its skills.
post.description: A skill code the pod has no row for is copied from the shared catalogue, or kept as a draft when the catalogue has none.

patch.summary: Changes a goal's status or skills.

get.summary: Lists a learner's reports, newest first.

post.summary: Makes a report on a learner from the evidence: code's digest, no narrative yet.
post.description: Rebuilds the learner's mastery first. When the evidence has not changed since the last report, the new one is a copy of its digest, `reused: true`.

patch.summary: Writes a report's narrative once, or records the parent's decisions on its proposals.
patch.description: A 2nd narrative is 409 `WriteOnce`; a decision on a proposal the digest does not have is 400 `BadRequest`.

post.summary: Starts a conversation with the AI in the caller's pod.
post.description: Idempotent by `event_id`: a resend makes nothing new and returns the same conversation.

post.summary: Sends the parent's message, on the open turn or a new one.
post.description: Idempotent by `event_id`: a resend returns the run that holds the message, and the same `event_id` with other text is 409 `EventIdMismatch`. The reply comes before the AI answers: read the run's events for its answer.

get.summary: Lists a conversation's runs, one per turn, oldest first.
Lists a run's events after a cursor, in `seq` order.
get.description: `after` is the last `seq` the caller holds, 0 or left out for the whole log. The events are append-only, so a cursor never misses one.

post.summary: Asks a run to stop at its next step.
post.description: Idempotent by `event_id`. A run that has already ended is returned as it is. The run stops at its next step, so read its events for `cancelled`.

post.summary: Searches the question bank: a need in, ranked questions out.
post.description: Called with the bank's shared read token, not a Supabase token.

get.summary: Reads one bank question's body, with its answer key.
get.description: Called with the bank's shared read token, not a Supabase token: without it the reply is 401, whatever the id.

BankQuestionId.description: A bank question's id: a Khan item id such as x1a2b3c4, letters, digits, _ and - only

words.description: The need in plain words, in the caller's language

words_en.description: English terms for the keyword arm when the need is not in English; never stored on a page

resemble.description: A task to resemble, e.g. a homework problem's text

grade.description: Canonical form: the bare number, e.g. "3"

Need.description: A search need, from jadwigo-bank schemas/need.schema.json at commit 703b679. It carries at least one of words, skills, can_do or resemble.

ref.description: The picture's sha256 with its extension, under <source>/media/ in the bucket

QuestionBody.description: One bank question's private body from questions/<source>/<id>.json: a version per language with its family, data, key and help, the credit and the pictures by sha; a question with no playable variant yet carries only id, credit and problem_type; it reaches only a caller with the read token

arm.description: The arm that answered (A, A1, B, B1, C, C2)

bank_rev.description: sha256 of the index manifest the service answered from; the publisher writes it with the rows, so a caller can tell which build of the bank a row came from

best_view.description: The index view the vector hit came from: title, samples, meaning_pl, meaning_en, needs

source.description: Where the set's questions come from: khan, own, ai

credit.description: The attribution line the product must show: Khan Academy, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and the exercise's URL

spot.description: How the mistake shows in one answer

enrichment.description: The set's enrichment fields the caller may show, each the set page's value: summary and can_do by language, mistake_classes as records, contexts as word lists by language; any other key, a private body among them, is dropped on parse

content_hash.description: sha256 of the set page the row was built from

media.description: shas of the pictures the set's questions need

items.description: How many questions the set holds (the bank's field name)

body.description: A private body never crosses this route

private_body.description: A private body never crosses this route

detail.description: What degraded it (an embedder or reranker failure), never a key or a URL with a token

state.description: One row per known arm: the asked arm's outcome and not_asked for the rest

SearchEnvelope.description: A bank search's answer, version 1, from jadwigo-bank schemas/search-envelope.schema.json at commit 703b679.

Error.description:
An error: `{error: {type, message}}`. The type names the cause, and answers with one status:

- 400: `BadRequest`, `ServerFieldSupplied`
- 401: `NotSignedIn`, `Unauthorized`
- 404: `NotFound`
- 409: `AccountMissing`, `AttemptClaimed`, `AttemptPreview`, `AssignmentClosed`, `AttemptFinished`, `AttemptNotFinished`, `AttemptPaused`, `QuestionNotOpen`, `TryOutOfOrder`, `AnswerConflict`, `EventIdMismatch`, `WriteOnce`
- 429: `AnswerLimit`, `MessageLimitMinute`, `MessageLimitDay`
- 502: `BankUnavailable`

bearerAuth.description: A Supabase Auth access token for a signed-in adult. API Gateway's JWT authorizer verifies it.

bankToken.description: The question bank's shared read token, not a Supabase token. The API checks it itself.
